notes.title: Island and Performance Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there![/h1]

This new update will focus on performance and a new arena! I have changed some settings and optimized a lot of the game so hopefully it will not hog 90% GPU anymore :)

[h3]Island Arena[/h3]
This new Arena is smaller than the previous ones and it has less enemies, but they are stronger and deal WAY more damage.

[h3]Change Basic Punch[/h3]
There is now an option to reroll basic attack to any other passive or spell. This is quite fun to play around with I think.

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Life regen and Life siphon has gotten a heavy nerf. I saw that it was quite easy to get a lot of regen and it was not hard to obtain AFK builds. With this change it will be a bit harder :)
[*] Earth boulder nerfed a lot and other underperforming spells got some buffs.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs and QOL[/h3]
As always a lot of tiny bugs and QOL stuff has been fixed as well so the game will be a better experience now :)

notes.title: Spells Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello all! [/h2]

This new update contains 10 new spells, Endless checkbox for all levels and difficulties, Artifact drops and unlearn spell drops, and much more!

[h2]Patch notes!!!!![/h2]

[h3]Spells![/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 6 new actives and 4 new passives
[*] balanced and optimized many other spells and level 10 upgrades
[*] Leveling a spell from 9-10 now has custom text that explains the level 10 upgrade.
[/list]
[h3]New difficulty levels and endless toggle![/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an enemy strenght slider. You can now make game harder or easier!
[*] Added endless toggle option. can be used for all modes!
[/list]
[h3]Drops![/h3]
[list]
[*] Added artifact drop which gives a strong buff but with a drawback!
[*] Added reroll drop that lets you unlearn a spell and choose a new one!
[/list]
[h3]Bugs and QOL![/h3]
[list]
[*] Black goo now reduce all healing by 80% instead of 100%.
[*] Meta Enhancement upgrades now go to level 7 instead of 5.
[/list]

There is a big chance I have missed some changes since I do a lot of stuff and sometimes forget but lets just call those "hidden changes" :D

notes.title: Minor bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Fixed some minor bugs with UI
Fixed Fields Master Speedrunner achievement was not possible to obtain.
Added text that shows limit to stats.

notes.title: The Fields Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello all! [/h2]

The Fields is the a new Arena and the focus of this update!
The Fields has a different gamemode. Similar to other Survivors-like. constantly oncoming enemies, enemies drop Coins that need to be picked up and so on. Hope you enjoy!

[h2]Patch notes!!!!![/h2]

[h3]Arena and Gamemode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new arena and new gamemode
[*] Buffed all bosses to be a bit stronger
[*] Added new boss to new Arena
[*] Rebalanced enemy health. A bit less health torwards the later rounds now.
[/list]
[h3]Spells![/h3]
[list]
[*]Frost Orbit - Buffed Damage
[*]Wind Vacuum - nerfed Cooldown
[*]Heat Beams - Buffed Damage and Optimized
[*] Skills that have been mastered (level 10) now have a permanent visual indication.
[/list]
[h3]New difficulty level![/h3]
[list]
[*] A fourth difficulty has been discovered! Enemies are harder than ever and there is no end in sight.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs![/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed spell meta upgrades acting weird and resetting on restarts.
[*] Some spells have better logic with illusions.
[*] Knockback and knockup now works properly. Sometimes didn't apply correctly
[*] And many other various minor QOL stuff.
[/list]
There is a big chance I have missed some changes since I do a lot of stuff and sometimes forget but lets just call those "hidden changes" :D

notes.title: Launch update!
notes.notes:
Next Fest is over and Spell Defender launches at last!

With this new patch you can now learn and use [b]10 MORE SPELLS!![/b]

[b]V-Sync[/b] and [b]Inverted controls[/b] support added!

And as always, [b]fixed bugs[/b] and fiddled with some [b]balance changes.[/b]

Hope you enjoy! <3

notes.title: Steam Next Fest update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Next Fest Demo Patch![/h1]

In Preperation of the Next Fest I have updated some things in the Demo.

[h2] Top-Down mode[/h2]
There is now an option to choose Top-Down when selecting difficulty. This will make the camera top down and game will have twin-stick controls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42867858/8ae2148afca850026cfd0cca3484005f32677edc.png[/img]

[h2]New pickup[/h2]
Added a new pickup that will boost all stats for a short duration
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42867858/a92d4a631484d74783ce32e3482f6e2c42bc29d5.png[/img]

[h2]Controller Support (kinda)[/h2]
Added controller support for in-game. The menu does not support controller but gameplay does.

[h2]Bugs, balancing, performance, and other goodie stuff[/h2]
Balanced some waves that were way too hard.
Bosses can no longer spawn infinite minions that tank FPS.
Added short descriptions when a new enemy type is encountered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42867858/29398bae440a4f656c16689827d0fce909dd0ad1.png[/img]
